$comment: Model tiers. Agents in agents/*.md declare `tier:`, never a model; this file says which
model each assistant runs for that tier. The plugin builds render it into every generated
agent. `tiers` is ordered cheapest first: the order a failing output escalates in.
`null` means the assistant's own default model.
claude: aliases (haiku, sonnet, opus) or full ids.
kiro: only ids Kiro's model service lists; claude-sonnet-4 is the one documented id, so
frontier falls back to Kiro's default until a stronger id is confirmed.
opencode: provider/model. null everywhere: the method does not choose a provider, so
every agent runs on the model the consumer's OpenCode configuration selects.
